description: Format references and in-text citations to IEEE style, and prepare Index Terms and IEEEtran bibliography setup. Use this whenever the user needs to "format references in IEEE", "fix my bibliography", "convert these citations to IEEE", "make a .bib for IEEEtran", "number my citations", "参考文献改成 IEEE 格式", "整理引用", or asks how in-text numbered citations and the reference list should look for an IEEE journal. Also covers Index Terms and EDICS selection ("选 EDICS", "Index Terms 怎么写"). Never fabricate DOIs, page numbers, volumes, EDICS codes, or any bibliographic field — flag missing metadata instead.
